searchText: Is there documentation about how clients (in particular Geth, but curious about others as well) handle the tx pool? Like if a new transaction is received, how is it decided if it gets added to the pool or not, and if the pool is full which transaction is dropped in exchange? also happy to dig through the code myself if anyone could point me to the right place to start at
